name: Operatör girdi erişimi

steps.API unit tests: PASS - 10086 passed, 5 skipped (919 s); was 10015 after B27
steps.Windows agent build + tests: PASS - 921/921 (920 + the new lab test, on this desktop)

local_gate.web_gates: vitest matrix-badges 12 passed (generated matrix module resynced); no web source changed

what_this_proves: The operator's input the device has answered since M19 now has callers: one key or one chord (operator.key), the five pointer operations (operator.pointer), each a plan of activate -> ONE guarded input -> read back; a focus-guard refusal stops the send and the receipt counts what ran; the device's `secret` flag is sent from the cloud; raw coordinates are refused unless declared the last resort, and the receipt records the rung used.

measured_first.device_half: keyboard.key / keyboard.shortcut / pointer.* implemented in PagentOS.SessionCompanion.Operator.OperatorCapabilities behind FocusGuard; RefuseSecret reads payload["secret"]; KeyMap holds 27 key names and 3 modifiers. All of it unreached from Cloud Core (matrix 92-98: 'Çağıran yok').
measured_first.cloud_half_before: plans only for app.launch, window.*, keyboard.type, ui.inspect, terminal.execute; keyboard.type's payload carried no `secret`; the task receipt said status and plan name only; no coordinate policy outside the browser worker.
measured_first.lab_before: NotepadLifecycleTests already typed, read back through UI Automation and clicked on this desktop; no key, chord or scroll had ever been exercised for real.

closed_fully.91_keyboard_typing: type_text's payload now carries `secret`; the task receipt carries steps_completed/step_count/stopped_at/interaction_level; a focus_mismatch mid-plan ends the task with that class and 'Pencere önden çekildi efendim; gönderimi durdurdum.'
closed_fully.92_single_key: Intent OPERATOR_KEY ('Enter'a bas', 'Yukarı ok tuşuna bas', 'F5'e bas') -> operator.key -> plan press_key (activate, keyboard.key, retries=0) -> postcondition: the device echoes the key and the foreground is still the target.
closed_fully.93_shortcuts: 'Ctrl S'ye bas' -> key_press 'ctrl+s' -> plan press_shortcut; the server's valid_shortcut is the companion's ValidateShortcut rule (modifiers then exactly one key); a chord is sent once.
closed_fully.94_97_move_click_double_right: operator.pointer with last_resort=true and a reason: activate, pointer.<action>, postcondition = device cursor within 2 px of screen_x/y AND the foreground still the target; a cursor read back elsewhere is postcondition_failed, never verified.
closed_fully.98_scroll: 'Aşağı kaydır.' -> OPERATOR_SCROLL -> operator.pointer scroll at the window's own centre from the device's rect (fallback (50,50) when no rect), delta -3 / +3; no last-resort gate (no element is targeted).
closed_fully.104_screenshot: Closed in B27 (operator.screenshot -> screen.capture); the matrix row was updated there.
closed_fully.107_last_resort: operator.pointer refuses move/click without last_resort=true: refused receipt `coordinate_not_last_resort`, no window resolved, no device call; with it, `last_resort_reason` and interaction_level=pointer travel in the receipt. The receipt's interaction_level is the HIGHEST rung any step used (_LEVEL_RANK).
closed_fully.109_secret_flag: plans.type_text computes `secret` with the same contains_secret_reference the server gate uses and puts it on the wire; the test reads OperatorCapabilities.cs for payload["secret"] and RefuseSecret(payload). The server gate still refuses first (test kept).
closed_fully.110_per_action_receipt: Every operator action is one action.receipt with the accounting fields; asserted over a key press and a scroll through the real relay.

found_on_the_way.fields_that_never_travelled: The relay test showed `key_press` never reached the tool: record_client_events copies the resolved intent into the turn record field by field, and the list is explicit. B27's `capability_family` and `media_volume_direction` were missing too — B27's unit tests built the turn record by hand and could not see it. All four added; a relay test on B27's fields added to test_daily_intent_tools.py.
found_on_the_way.clarifying_tools_list: 'Hangi tuş?' from operator.key was recorded as a SUCCEEDED call: the relay maps needs_clarification only for tools in OPERATOR_CLARIFYING_TOOLS. Both new tools added.
found_on_the_way.regression_plan_table: test_operator_capability_regression drives every declared plan through the real service; the seven new plans had to be added to its PLAN_STEPS or the receipt set would not match RECEIPT_BY_PLAN.

red_first_proof.method: Executed mutations, each restored from a sha256-verified backup copy (never `git checkout --`).
mutations: a refused key is sent again (retries=1) -> 1 failure (focus guard accounting).
partial send not accounted (steps_completed = step_count) -> 1 failure.
the pointer never checks where it landed -> 1 failure.

runtime_proof.why: REAL_PROOF_REQUIRED is 'PROVEN_REAL — üretimden verilen bir komut gerçek pencerede iş yaptı, postcondition doğrulandı, FocusGuard ihlali kaydedilmedi'. The lab half is real on this desktop: Home moved the caret of a real Notepad (the next typed letter appeared at the front: 'Xabc'), Ctrl+A then Delete emptied the document (read back through UI Automation), pointer.scroll re-observed the cursor within 2 px — every assertion on the companion's own read-back, no focus_mismatch recorded. The production half (a command from the deployed Cloud Core to the enrolled device) is Karar 0's owner round.

owner_gates.karar_0: production release round: one spoken 'Enter'a bas' from the deployed core into a real window
